description: Service split for the jira provider. Ordered rules, first match wins; a rule matches when every criterion it states holds: spec (platform | software, the keys of SPECS in lib/spec_helpers.mjs), tags (the operation's first vendor tag is one of them) and pathRegex (a JavaScript regex against the full vendor path). Every operation must match a rule or bin/split.mjs and build_inventory.mjs fail without writing. A rule with "excluded": true classifies the operation for the inventory but the service is never emitted; its "skip" code is the reason recorded in the inventory. "services" carries the title and description written into each service document, and "stripLeading": the leading path segments the service name already says, dropped before resource names are derived (/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/comment -> comments in the issues service).
